aiPatterns.label: AI sentence patterns
aiPatterns.note: Regex sources, to be compiled with the "gi" flags.

terms.name: negative-parallelism
terms.pattern: \bn(?:ot|[''’]t) (?:just|only|merely|simply|about) [^.!?\n]{1,80}?[,;.:—–-] ?(?:it[''’]s|it is|this is|that[''’]s|they[''’]re|but rather)\b|\b(?:it|this|that)(?:[''’]s| is) not (?:a|an|the) [^.!?\n]{1,60}?[.;,—–] ?(?:it|this|that)(?:[''’]s| is) (?:a|an|the)\b
terms.reason: "It's not just X — it's Y" negative parallelism is a signature LLM construction (WP:AISIGNS; Kriss/NYT 2025)

terms.name: not-only-but-also
terms.reason: "not only... but also" is heavily overused by LLMs of every generation (Russell 2025; WP:AISIGNS)

terms.name: trailing-participial-analysis
terms.reason: Trailing ", highlighting/underscoring/showcasing..." significance clauses are the best-evidenced syntactic AI tell (Reinhart PNAS 2025; WP:AISIGNS)

terms.name: vague-attribution
terms.reason: Vague authority attribution ("experts agree", "studies show") without a named source is a documented AI weasel pattern (WP:AISIGNS)

terms.name: audience-hedge
terms.reason: "Whether you're a X or a Y" audience-flattening openers are an AI content-marketing formula

terms.name: despite-challenges
terms.reason: The "Despite its X, [subject] faces challenges" formula is a documented AI outline habit (WP:AISIGNS; Russell 2025)

terms.name: copula-puffery
terms.pattern: \bstands as an?\b|\bholds the distinction of\b|\bserves as a (?:testament|beacon|reminder|symbol|cornerstone)\b
terms.reason: Inflated copulas ("stands as a", "serves as a testament") replace plain "is" in AI prose (WP:AISIGNS; Geng & Trotta 2025)

terms.name: pivotal-role-claim
terms.reason: "plays a crucial/vital/key role" is an AI significance cliche (WP:AISIGNS grandiose-phrase list)

terms.name: false-range
terms.reason: Chained "from X to Y, from Z to W" false ranges are a documented AI comprehensiveness gesture (WP:AISIGNS)

terms.name: unfilled-placeholder
terms.reason: Unfilled template placeholders ("[Your Name]", "[insert X]") are AI draft output left incomplete (WP:AISIGNS)

terms.name: meta-announcement
terms.reason: "This article aims to explore..." meta-announcements are ~50x more frequent in AI text (GPTZero)

terms.name: dance-metaphor
